ValidationRule.description: US-06 AC1: an invoice needs the name (or company), the person type and the RFC.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Donation', Invoice_Requested__c, OR(ISBLANK(RFC__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Person_Type__c)), IF(ISPICKVAL(Person_Type__c, 'Company'), ISBLANK(Donor_Company__c), OR(ISBLANK(Donor_First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Donor_Last_Name__c)))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Para solicitar factura captura tu nombre (o el de tu empresa), el tipo de persona y tu RFC.
